# Knowledge and hooks

## Knowledge (`references/`)

Put markdown files in a `references/` folder, at the agent root or inside a skill.
At train time every `**/*.md` file is split into overlapping character chunks and
embedded, and the agent gets the built-in `search_knowledge` tool. Search hits are
**sections of a file**, not whole documents, so a large FAQ can stay in one file.

- Both locations feed one index, and a search covers all of it whatever skill is
  active. Write each document so it stands on its own.
- Chunking defaults are `chunk_size: 1000` and `chunk_overlap: 20`, in characters,
  set under `knowledge_answering.chunking` in `agent.yml`. Overlap must be smaller
  than size, and unknown keys under `chunking` fail the load.
- Serving does not re-read `references/` from disk: a document change takes effect
  after the next train.

## Hooks

Hooks are optional `async` functions at the agent root that run at fixed insertion
points without replacing core components. Put them in `hooks.py` and/or
`hooks/**/*.py` (both layouts may coexist; `__init__.py` is skipped). Import the
decorators and payloads from `rasa.mantle.hooks`. Parentheses on every decorator
are mandatory.

The runtime currently invokes:

- `on_incoming_message` / `modify_incoming_message` on the final user text before
  it is stored
- `on_turn_started` / `on_turn_finished` around each Mantle turn
- `on_model_request` / `modify_model_request` on each main model loop iteration
- `on_model_response` / `modify_model_response` after each main-loop completion
- `on_tool_call` / `modify_tool_call` before each tool dispatch
- `on_tool_result` / `modify_tool_result` after each tool returns
- `on_outgoing_text` / `modify_outgoing_text` on each completed agent utterance
- `on_knowledge_query` / `modify_knowledge_query` before an index search (rewrite the
  query; a crash or timeout skips the search) and `on_knowledge_results` /
  `modify_knowledge_results` after retrieval (filter or reorder passages; a crash or
  timeout keeps the original hits)

Other catalogue points can be authored, validated, and packaged, but are not invoked
yet.

- Observe hooks (`on_*`) may be many per point and run concurrently.
- Modify hooks (`modify_*`) are one per point, awaited, and may return an updated
  payload or raise a control signal (`HookRejection`, `RetryModel`).
- An incoming-message rejection may name a response with
  `HookRejection.response_message`; otherwise `utter_incoming_message_rejected` is
  sent. Outgoing-text rejections fall back to `utter_outgoing_text_rejected`. Both
  can be overridden in the project `responses.yml`.
